$comment: Canonical kalkan finding contract (docs/ENGINE-SPEC.md section 5). Base: report-schema.json of cloudflare/security-audit-skill@c1c8a8c (MIT, Copyright (c) 2025-2026 Cloudflare, Inc.). kalkan keeps every base field and rule and adds optional fields to the three branches (cvss only to confirmed). kalkan.schema.validator interprets this schema; kalkan.findings.validate adds the checks that the schema cannot express.

oneOf.description: A source-grounded vulnerability that was independently demonstrated.

fingerprint.description: A stable source-derived identifier that does not change between validation states.

execution.description: Target-neutral reproduction in the target's native interface.

owasp.description: kalkan: OWASP IDs, for example A03:2021 or LLM01:2025.

engines.description: kalkan: engines and agent roles that produced or confirmed the finding.

candidates.description: kalkan: IDs of the candidates merged into this finding.

audit_answers.description: kalkan: quote-backed answers to the three audit questions (ENGINE-SPEC 6.3).

poc.description: kalkan: proof-of-concept run in the sandbox.

blocker.description: kalkan: why the PoC did not pass or did not run (sandbox_timeout, sandbox_output_limit, ...).

started_at.description: kalkan: UTC start time of the container run (ISO 8601).

duration_ms.description: kalkan: wall-clock time of the container run.

exit_code.description: kalkan: exit code of the harness; absent when the engine stopped the container.

output_truncated.description: kalkan: the container printed more than the engine keeps.

i18n.description: kalkan: English texts for the report (the record prose is Turkish).

review.description: kalkan: decision of the final independent review (Cloudflare Phase 5).

duplicate_of.description: kalkan: the primary record that holds the same root cause and the same fix (consolidation, ENGINE-SPEC section 15). The counts leave this record out.

duplicate_reason.description: kalkan: why this record has the root cause of its primary record.

related.description: kalkan: the records that consolidation folded into this primary record.

poc_status.description: kalkan: the PoC status of the folded record, when it had one.

cvss.description: kalkan: CVSS vector and base score from 0 to 10 (kalkan.findings.validate checks the upper bound).
